messages.label: scam
messages.text: Canada Revenue: After reassessment of your 2025 return you are owed $391.07. Accept your deposit before it expires tonight: [link]
messages.note: CRA does not send refunds or deposit links by text; link steals login and banking info.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello, this is Mark with RBC card security. We flagged a $1,240 purchase at a Best Buy in Mississauga — was that you? No? Okay, we'll need to cancel and replace your cards. One of our agents will come by this afternoon to pick up the old ones, just seal them in an envelope. And please don't mention it at the branch, there may be an employee involved.
messages.note: Fake bank fraud call sending someone to collect cards and telling you not to tell branch staff.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller (crying): Grandpa, it's me... I messed up, I got pulled over and they found something in the car that wasn't mine. I'm at the station. They said if I get $4,000 for bail tonight I can go home. Please don't call Mom, she'll freak out. A man from the court is going to call you.
messages.note: Fake grandchild in custody asking for urgent secret bail money.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: hi!! sorry this is weird, I was trying to log into my insta on a new phone and I think I typed your number by accident 🙈 you should have just got a text with 6 numbers, could you send it to me? thank you sm
messages.note: Hard: friendly ask for a one-time code that was really generated to take over the recipient's account.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, I am very interested in the dining table. I am away on a ship so cannot view, but I trust you. I have sent $950 to cover the table plus the pickup agent. Please e-Transfer back $300 to the agent when you get it and he will collect on Thursday. God bless.
messages.note: Hard-ish: polite buyer who can't view and overpays, asks for refund of the difference.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, thanks for your interest in the 1 bedroom on Bloor. I'm currently in Calgary taking care of my mother so I can't do viewings, but my agent can courier the keys. I've had 14 inquiries so I'm going with whoever confirms first. Please e-Transfer $1,450 (first month) and I'll send the signed lease.
messages.note: Landlord can't show the unit, pressure from other applicants, deposit before viewing.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, my name is Sarah, a hiring coordinator. We're looking for part-time online assistants to help merchants optimize product data. 1 hour/day, paid $180-$420 daily, training provided. Message me to learn more.
messages.note: Unsolicited remote task job; leads to depositing crypto to unlock earnings.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hey Kevin, are we still on for the golf Saturday? I booked the 9am tee time
messages.note: Hard: 'wrong number' opener used to start a friendship that ends in crypto investment coaching.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is the collections department at Hydro One. Your account shows an overdue balance of $612 and our crew is scheduled to cut your service within the hour. To stop the disconnection you can pay right now using a prepaid Visa or at a Bitcoin machine, and I'll stay on the line with you.
messages.note: Threat of same-day power cut with payment by prepaid card or Bitcoin.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is Officer Grant from Service Canada. We found a rental car registered with your SIN at the border with drugs and cash inside. Your SIN is suspended and police will come to your home today. To protect your assets you must withdraw your savings and deposit them into the secure government terminal I'll send you by WhatsApp. Do not hang up.
messages.note: Fake government official threatening arrest and directing cash into a Bitcoin ATM via QR code.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: We're closing our Canadian warehouse 😢 All Canada Goose parkas $89, final day! Ships free coast to coast. Tap to shop before they're gone [link]
messages.note: Social ad for a copycat store with impossibly cheap branded goods.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello Daniel, 14 Maple Cres. Your password is known to me. I put a program on your device months ago and filmed you through the webcam while you visited certain sites. Transfer $1,900 in BTC to the address below in 2 days and the files are deleted. Otherwise everyone in your contact list gets them.
messages.note: Sextortion email using leaked personal data and a fake recording to demand Bitcoin.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: TD: Your verification code is [number]. It expires in 10 minutes. We will never call or text you asking for this code. Do not share it with anyone.
messages.note: Genuine bank OTP that warns not to share; no link or request.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Canada Post: Your parcel [number] was delivered to your community mailbox. Your key is in compartment 2. Track in the Canada Post app.
messages.note: Real delivery notice, nothing to pay or confirm.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Dad, can you e-Transfer me $120 for my textbook? The bookstore finally got the bio one in. I'll show you the receipt when I'm home for reading week. Love you
messages.note: Child from usual number, specific context, small amount, no secrecy.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: You have a new message from the Canada Revenue Agency. To view it, sign in to My Account through Canada.ca. For your security, this email does not contain any links.
messages.note: CRA-style notification with no link, tells you to sign in yourself.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: lol this is literally us trying to parallel park downtown [link]
messages.note: Friend sharing an article link from known contact, nothing asked.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Good morning families, due to the freezing rain warning, all buses for our school are cancelled today. The school remains open. Please make your own arrangements and let the office know if your child will be absent.
messages.note: Urgent school notice with nothing suspicious: no link, money or data.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Order confirmed! Thanks for shopping with us. Order #[number]: winter boots, size 9. Subtotal $129.99, HST $16.90, total $146.89. You'll get a shipping update once it's on its way.
messages.note: Ordinary order confirmation for a purchase made.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder from Lakeview Dental: Priya has a cleaning on Mon Nov 24 at 3:15 PM. Reply C to confirm or call the office to reschedule.
messages.note: Routine dental appointment reminder.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Jess! Switched to Fido so I have a new number now. Save this one. Still on for trivia Thursday?
messages.note: Friend with a new number asking for nothing.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi! Is the stroller still available? Any stains or damage? I'm in the east end, could come see it tomorrow evening.
messages.note: Normal buyer question, wants to see the item in person.
